description: Brief to PDF. Send a short brief; returns a 400 to 900 word document written from it, laid out as an A4 PDF (base64 in JSON) plus the Markdown text. Use for a one-page explainer, memo or checklist. It uses only the facts in the brief and general knowledge; no web search. Typical response 5 to 15 s. Failed calls are not charged. Costs $0.01 (USDC, x402).

brief.description: What the document should cover, who reads it, and any facts to include.
